## Tier (see docs/CHANGE-PROCESS.md)

- [ ] A. Routine
- [ ] B. Significant (privacy and safety check done)
- [ ] C. High-impact (advisor and child-protection sign-off)

## Checklist

- [ ] Another person has reviewed this (not just the author)
- [ ] Checks pass (build, tests, code scanning); none bypassed
- [ ] Does it collect, show or send new information about people? If yes: described below, and the privacy notice / DPIA / data map are updated
- [ ] Is it different for children under 13? Handled
- [ ] Database changes tested as a learner, a leader of another organization and a signed-out visitor
- [ ] Leaders told about anything they will notice (monthly update)
- [ ] Success measure written: how we will know this worked
